import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    freq = [0] * 10005
    for _ in range(n):
        val = int(next(it))
        freq[val] += 1
    t = int(next(it))
    ans = 0
    for i in range(t, 1001):
        s = 0
        for j in range(i - t + 1, i + 1):
            s += freq[j]
        if s > ans:
            ans = s
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
